play.title: Habitly: Habit Tracker & Diary
play.shortDescription: Build daily routines that stick, with gentle reminders and weekly reviews.
play.fullDescription:
Habitly is a habit tracker that helps busy people build routines that last. Set a goal, check it off, and watch your streak grow. The habit tracker adapts reminders to your day.

• Routines: morning and evening checklists
• Reviews: see which habits stick each week
• Widgets: check off a habit from the home screen

Use Habitly as a habit tracker, a mood journal, or a simple daily planner.
